sections.Profile:
Peter Brock – “King Of The Mountain” and Holden Heritage are two licensed pinball machines by Vector Pinball. The two games are based on the same playfield layout but are styled based on two different licensed themes, both focused on the worlds of Australian automobiles and car racing.

- Manufacturer: Vector Pinball
- Years made: 2025
- In production: yes
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Solid State, Australia
sections.Design Team:

- Design: Jason McNally
- Art: Jeremy Ham
